Commentary.Commentary: Not quite sure what the mindset of the batting team was - they just kept throwing wickets away. However, the pitch is spinning a big deal and the visitors will have their hands full. Around 40 overs left for the evening. Stay tuned.

Just 5 balls needed for West Indies to wrap up the innings after the break. Bishoo has wrecked the Pakistan batting line-up. He has figures of 8/49 and has managed to reduce the target to under 350, whereas Pakistan would have loved to touch 450.

OUT! BOWLED! Wicket number 8 for Bishoo, the first by a bowler in the UAE. A short ball outside off, Amir backs away to cut but the ball spins in, takes a little bit of the inside edge and hits the stumps. PAKISTAN HAVE SET A TARGET OF 346 TO THE WEST INDIES.
An LBW appeal but nothing in it. Full and outside off. Amir comes forward to defend but misses and is hit on the pads. Impact was perhaps outside off.
The googly now, spins in from outside off, Sohail goes back and punches it down to long on for a run.
A full toss outside off, pushed down to long off for a single to get off the mark.
MOHAMMAD AMIR is the last man in.

OUT! Stumped! A wicket first ball after the break! Flighted outside off, Sarfraz jumps out of his crease and looks to push it through the off side but he is nowhere near the pitch of the ball and misses. He is way too far down the track and Shane Dowrich has an easy stumping.
The players make their way out to the middle. SOHAIL KHAN joins Sarfraz Ahmed as the number 10 batsman. Bishoo to start off proceedings to Sarfraz.
Welcome back. What a dramatic session for the Windies. They have bounced back nicely to have an outside chance in the game. They need 2 wickets to quickly wrap up this Pakistani innings.
... DAY 4, FINAL SESSION ...

The pitch has started to wear and tear. Pakistan will be unhappy with the way they lost wickets in this session but they are 343 runs ahead, which looks like a bountiful. One does not see any real reason for Pakistan to continue batting but Misbah may want to stretch the target to say, 375. Join us back at 2200 IST (1630 GMT) for the final session of the evening.

100/6 IN 25.2 OVERS. What a session. It was Bishoo all the way through as he ran through the middle order of Pakistan. He was well supported by the others as well who did not bowl too many loose balls, hence did not allow Pakistan to break free.

OUT! Caught and bowled! Totally unnecessary. A short ball outside off, Yasir goes for the pull but it is a half-hearted one. Gets a top edge and Holder calmly gets to his right to take the catch. SUPPER ON DAY 4, PAKISTAN ARE EFFECTIVELY 343/8!
A bouncer outside off, Shah sways away.
A short ball down the leg side, worked towards fine leg for a single.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Outside off, left alone.

Full and outside off, punched down the ground. Roston Chase gets to the ball from mid on, turns around and has a shy but it is a weak one and is wide. Meanwhile, Yasir dives and nearly collides with the umpire.
Short and outside off, coming in, punched down to long on for a single.
YASIR SHAH comes in at number 9, replacing Riaz.

OUT! A 6-fer for Bishoo! He is on a roll. Tosses this outside off, Riaz reaches out and looks to slog sweep. Hits it high in the air but finds Kraigg Brathwaite at the boundary who pouches it with a jump. He was the lone fielder in that area. PAKISTAN ARE EFFECTIVELY 340/7.
Outside off, Wahab looks to run it down to third man but gets a thick inside edge towards mid on.
FOUR! The attempted googly turns into a full toss, Riaz reaches out and sweeps it overs square leg for a boundary. He was on his knee even before the ball was delivered. The lead moves to 340.
Outside off, pushed towards point.
Almost another one. Landed outside off, Riaz looks to run this down to third man but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.
Outside off, short in length, played through point for a single.
A bouncer to Riaz, he ducks.
Outside off, pushed to mid off.
A short ball outside off, Riaz sways away.
A short ball outside off, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
Excellent yorker on middle, well dug out.
WAHAB RIAZ walks in at number 8, replacing Nawaz.

OUT! Bowled! Third 5-wicket haul in Tests for Bishoo! What a spell of bowling. Nawaz looks bemused as he walks back for a duck. This is full and wide outside off, well tossed up, Nawaz gets a long stride in and then lets it go. However, the ball spins in a mile, goes past the pad and hits the top of off stump! A beautiful ball. Not a bad time to get a 5-wicket haul.
A short leg comes in place now.
Full and outside off, Nawaz looks to defend but the ball spins and bounces and goes off the inside edge. No short leg in place to take the catch.
Landed around off, defended to the leg side.
MOHAMMAD NAWAZ walks in at number 7, replacing Misbah. Around 17 minutes to go to Supper.

OUT! Another drag on! Fourth wicket for Bishoo. The googly is followed by a straighter one. Tosses it up outside off, on a fuller length, Misbah gets down on a knee to try and slog sweep but the ball turns away and goes off the inside edge onto the stumps. A rare failure for Misbah who departs for 15. PAKISTAN ARE EFFECTIVELY 334/5.
The googly outside leg, goes quickly, skids on, Misbah looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads.
A short ball outside off, spinning away, pulled down to long on for a single.
A short ball outside off, Misbah goes for the hook but misses. That was quick and bouncy.
A short ball on middle, Sarfraz hops and pulls it to deep backward square leg for a run.
Short and outside off, cut through point for a run.
A short ball outside off, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, played straight to point.
Around off, on a length, punched down to mid on.
Action replay of 25.4. Only this time the batsmen get a single. The lead moves to 330. Sarfraz moves to 10.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Comes down the track, takes the ball on the full and whips it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Shortish, punched down the ground for a single.
Comes down the track to flick but is not to the pitch of the ball and gets a leading edge to cover.

EDGED BUT SAFE! Fortuitous. Landed outside off, turning away, Sarfraz looks to punch it away but the ball takes the outside edge and goes to the left of Blackwood at first slip who is standing a bit wide. He chases it down but the batsmen have enough time to take three. The stand moves to 11 in 10 balls.
Outside off, pushed through point for another single.
A wayward bouncer, well above the batsman, Misbah ducks.
Fullish on middle, pushed wide of mid on for a quick one.
A bouncer outside off, Sarfraz ducks.
A short ball outside off, pulled over square leg for a run. The lead moves to 320.
On a good length outside off, angling in, worked through square leg for a single.
JASON HOLDER brings himself on to bowl now.
Full on off and middle, Misbah gets down and sweeps it towards short fine leg, Bishoo was just about to appeal before he saw the bat coming down.
Outside off, cut through point for one.
Full and outside off, swept to deep backward square leg for a run. Moves to 10.
EDGED, SAFE! Full and outside off, turning away, Misbah lunges to defend but gets a thick outside edge due to the extra bounce. The ball lobs in the air but does not carry to backward point.
Straightaway he gets off the mark. Landed outside off, turning away, short in length, cut through point for a single.
SARFRAZ AHMED walks in at number 6, replacing Aslam.

OUT! That is a fantastic catch! Take a bow, Blackwood. That is an exceptional piece of fielding. Short and outside off, Aslam goes back and runs it down to third man but hits it too fine. Jermaine Blackwood at first slip reacts quickly and takes it inches above the turf. The third umpire checks for the legality of the ball and the catch but both are fine and Aslam has to go. PAKISTAN ARE EFFECTIVELY 315/4.
Landed outside off, Haq looks to steer it to third man but misses.
Short and outside off, steered behind point for a run.
Full and straight, driven straight down the ground. Roston Chase gets to his left from mid on and dives to save the boundary. A single taken.
NO BALL! This time the call comes as Gabriel oversteps again. Short and outside off, Misbah stands tall and punches it behind point for a couple.
Full and around off, pushed back to the bowler. Replays show that it was another massive no ball. Missed by umpire Illingworth.
Landed outside off, Misbah loosely hangs his bat outside off and looks to steer it behind point but misses.
Full and outside off, driven back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, Aslam drives it uppishly towards mid off. Does not carry.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Full and outside off, watchfully blocked out.
Landed outside off, driven towards mid off.
Full and outside off, defended back to the bowler.
Full and around off, swept towards backward square leg.
The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man.
A short ball on middle, Misbah pulls it towards fine leg, albeit a bit uncomfortably. A run taken.
A short ball outside off, Misbah looks to pull but misses and is hit on the abdomen.
Flicks it away for one.
Outside off, pushed through point for a run.
On middle and leg, tucked through square leg for a single.
SHANNON GABRIEL is back on.
Full and outside off, swept straight to square leg.
Pushes this down to long on for one more.
Short and outside off, punched through the off side for a run.
Full and on middle, pushed down to long on for a single. Moves to 40.
Around off, pushed towards short leg.
Full and outside off, Aslam lunges to defend but the ball spins in, takes the inside edge but goes to short fine leg.
A bouncer on middle, Misbah ducks.
Full and outside off, driven back to the bowler.
On a good length outside off, not played at again.
A short ball outside off, Misbah sways away from the line. The ball bounces in front of the keeper.
Around off, defended to the off side.
Full and outside off, pushed down to mid off for a single. PAKISTAN'S LEAD TOUCHES 300.
Full and outside off, driven back to the bowler.
Unwinds himself, goes for a big slog, but the ball goes off the inside half of the bat through mid-wicket. Two runs taken.
Shorter in length, outside off, cut straight to point.
Full and outside off, Misbah lunges and defends.
Skipper MISBAH-UL-HAQ walks in at number 5, replacing Babar. A quickfire century or a half century perhaps?

OUT! Drags it on! Second wicket for Bishoo. Azam was never looking comfortable at the crease and he is walking back now. A shortish ball around middle and off, pretty harmless, turning away, Azam tries to work this to the leg side but perhaps the footwork was not that great and he gets a thick inside edge onto his right pad and then the stumps. PAKISTAN ARE EFFECTIVELY 299/3.
Tossed up outside off, Azam comes forward and defends.
Outside off, punched through the point region for one.

A short ball around off, Azam ducks and once again, the ball curls away from the batsman after pitching. The bat was hanging in the air like a periscope and Aslam lets him know about that. Not the best technique.
Outside leg, tucked through square leg for a run.
A bouncer down the leg side this time, ducked under.
FOUR BYES! Poor bowling, poor keeping. A length ball way down the leg side, Aslam misses his flick and the keeper is unsighted by the ball and misses it too. The ball rolls to the fence.
Short and outside off, punched through the covers for a single.
50-run stand is up! In just 62 balls. Pakistan upping the ante here.

FOUR! Hmmm... Shapes up for the reverse sweep pretty early, the bowler lands it on middle and leg, Aslam is in a touch uncomfortable position but still goes through with the shot. Gets it behind point for a boundary. The lead moves to 292.
Thinks about coming down the track but is not confident and hence just lunges out, gets to the pitch of the ball, looks to defend but gets hit on the glove and the ball hits his pads.
Around off, pushed towards cover.
Comes forward a touch to this full ball and works it towards short mid-wicket again.
Around off, spinning in, but a touch short, defended comfortably towards short mid-wicket.
FOUR! Nicely done. He likes to sweep and demonstrates that again. Reaches out and sweeps it behind square leg for a boundary. Moves to 33 from just 42 balls.
A bouncer to end the over, Babar ducks.
Wow. What a ball. Short and down the leg side from around the wicket, Azam lets it go and the ball comes in a long, long way and even Dowrich is surprised and fumbles.
Outside off, steered behind point for a run.
Short on middle, swayed away from.
Around middle and off, punched towards covers.

FOUR! Just wide of the keeper! A short ball down the leg side, Aslam looks to tickle it fine but does not hit it all that well. The ball goes behind and Shane Dowrich dives to his right but in vain. The ball goes to the fine leg fence.
FOUR! Caressed! Full and outside off, Azam comes down the track and drives it beautifully through the covers for a boundary. 10 from the over.
On middle and off, well defended.
Short and outside off, punched down to long off for a couple.
Tossed up outside off, Babar comes down the track and drives it to the bowler again.
Full and outside off, pushed back to the bowler.

FOUR! Poor ball and punished. Bishoo drops it short and outside off, Azam goes back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary. 50 UP FOR PAKISTAN, the lead moves to 273. Azam moves to 13. The stand moves to 31.
A bouncer now, on middle, Sami looks to pull but misses. End of a dramatic over.
Dropped short again, pulled ferociously through mid-wicket for a couple.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Clunk! Short and around off, this time Azam is ready for it. Pulls it with disdain between mid on and mid-wicket for a boundary.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.

IT IS A NO BALL! Azam walks back to the crease. Another stroke of luck. First a dropped catch 4 balls ago and now this reprieve. A good short ball around off, angling in, Azam looks to duck and sway but is unable to get his bat out of the way. He is cramped for room and the ball goes off the gloves to the keeper. Cummins appeals but Azam walks straightaway. However, he is asked to wait as the umpire wants to check whether it is a legal delivery. Goodness me, Cummins' foot has landed on the line and the line belongs to the umpire. Azam walks back with a sheepish smile on his face.
Babar Azam is caught behind! But the umpire wants to check the overstepping.
Landed outside off, blocked towards point.
Landed outside off, steered through third man for a couple. The lead moves to 261.
Full and outside off again, Aslam lunges and blocks.
Around off, watchfully defended.
Full and tossed up outside off, driven straight to short extra cover.
On middle, tucked through mid-wicket for a single.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.

TOP EDGE...DROPPED! Tough luck for Cummins. He bends his back, digs it in short around off, gets it to come in with the angle, forces Babar into the pull and induces a top edge. Shannon Gabriel is stationed at deep fine leg while Kraigg Brathwaite is at deep backward square leg. Both look at each other, assuming that the other is going to go for the catch but neither goes. Eventually both start to run and it is Gabriel who puts in the hard yards. Dives to his left full length, gets fingertips to the ball but it bursts through. A single taken. Cummins applauds the effort. Poor guy.
Another bouncer outside off, Babar thinks about the pull but then bails out.
A bouncer outside off, ducked out of harm's way.
A length ball outside off, Azam pushes but misses.
Down the leg side, nudged fine for a single. Moves to 20.
Full and straight, pushed back to the bowler.
MIGUEL CUMMINS to bowl now.
Outside off, steered towards backward point.
Short and outside off, Babar looks to cut but gets a bottom edge to point.
Around off, driven back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, pushed towards cover again.
Landed outside off, punched straight to cover.

FOUR BYES! That missed everything. Landed on middle, a touch short, Azam backs away to the leg side and looks to punch it through the off side but is beaten and the ball bounces over the stumps and beats the keeper too! Races to the boundary behind.
Gabriel touches 150ks, bowls this on a length, Aslam clips it through mid-wicket and gets a couple. The stand moves to 10.
Down the leg side, Sami misses his flick.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
Landed outside off, guided to third man but gully intercepts.
Short and around off, Aslam sways away from the line.
Short and outside off, pretty wide, cut through point for a single. THE LEAD TOUCHES 250.
Landed outside off, Aslam lunges and defends.
Full again, driven through the covers for a couple.
Gets off the mark. Full and outside off, Babar pushes this through the covers and takes the single.
Stays back in his crease and blocks.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
A wild bouncer down the leg side, Azam ducks and the ball seams further down. Shane Dowrich dives to his left but cannot get to the ball and he parries it to fine leg. A bye taken.
Slightly short in length around leg, Aslam tucks it behind square leg for a single.
On middle and off, worked straight to square leg.
Around middle and off, Sami blocks it towards cover again.
On middle and off, defended towards cover.
Full and a little bit wide outside off, Aslam reaches out and guides it past a diving backward point. Miguel Cummins jogs to his left from third man and the batsmen hasten back for a couple.
SHANNON GABRIEL to continue from the other end.
Similar ball, action replay of the previous delivery.
Full and outside off, Azam comes forward and defends.
Welcome back. The players are back out in the middle. It will be BABAR AZAM to join forces with Sami Aslam as Bishoo completes his pending over. Here we go...
... DAY 4, SESSION 2 ...

Around 67 overs left in the evening. Pakistan will like to face at least 50 of those and score around 175-200 before inviting the visitors to bat again. The pitch is showing signs of breaking down and bowling will be fun now. Join us back at 1930 IST (1400 GMT) for the second session.

A decent passage of play for West Indies. They have managed to get rid of Azhar and Shafiq and walk with smiling faces to the dressing room. The bowling was done with some intent and Pakistan could not quite get runs easily.

OUT! LBW! That was dead plumb. Full and around off, Shafiq gets down to paddle but misses a straighter one. The ball hits him on the pads and goes to fine leg. Bishoo appeals but the umpire moves away and the batsmen go for the single. Shafiq sends his partner back and now Holder takes the review. The third umpire checks a lot of replays for the inside edge or glove but there is none and eventually he goes for the Hawk Eye. The impact is in line and the ball is shown to crash into middle and leg stumps. The decision is reversed and Pakistan are effectively 242/2! TEA ON DAY 4!
Another review. Bishoo feels he has his man and Asad Shafiq looks to be in trouble. It is regarding an LBW appeal.
On middle, pushed down to mid on for a single.
Comes down the track but is beaten in flight. However, Aslam recovers quickly and gets back in time as he misses his attempted cut. Dowrich whips off the bails but the batsman is in.
Full and outside off, pushed towards cover.
DEVENDRA BISHOO to bowl the final over before Tea.
FOUR! The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. The ball races to the boundary. The Umpire signals a boundary.
On a good length on middle, Asad bunts it towards short mid-wicket.
Three in a row, overdoing the short stuff, same reaction from Shafiq.
Another bouncer, Asad ducks again.
A bouncer on middle, Shafiq ducks.
Stays back in his crease and defends.
The batsman has played it to the point region. One run added to the total.
On a good length outside off, Shafiq pushes inside the line but then tries to withdraw his bat. Is beaten.
Outside off, cut behind point for a single.
On middle and off, angling away, watchfully defended.
On middle, pushed towards short mid-wicket.
Full and wide outside off, left alone.
ASAD SHAFIQ walks in at number 3, replacing Azhar. 10 minutes to go to Tea.

OUT! LBW! This time Azhar walks off! Full and fast, smearing down on middle, Azhar misses his flick and is hit flush on the pads. Gabriel appeals and the umpire raises his finger. Azhar has a chat with Aslam regarding the review and is advised not to take the review. Hawk Eye shows the ball to be kissing the leg stump, which means the umpire's call would have stayed. Finally some reward for the hard-working Gabriel.
He loses his run-up again! This time for a different reason though. Gabriel comes to bowl but oversteps by a big margin and realizes it immediately, hence pulls out.
Second time in this over. Gabriel comes running in but loses his run-up.
Well, it was refused a while ago but now, the ball is changed.

NOT OUT! Excellent review. A short ball around middle, Azhar gets across to pull but misses. There is a noise as the ball goes through to the keeper and West Indies appeal. Umpire Illingworth thinks for a while but then raises his finger. Azhar immediately takes the review and the replays instantly confirm that the ball missed the bat and glove and brushed the shirt. The decision is reversed. Poor Gabriel. He just stands over there looking at the pitch, then the batsman, then the keeper before trudging back. He is clearly not amused.
Azhar Ali has been adjudged caught behind! He has taken the review though.
Gabriel comes running in to bowl the 5th ball but loses his run-up, hence pulls out.
Fuller in length, pushed towards mid on.
On a good length around off, punched towards mid on.
Around off, watchfully defended.

There are some issues with the ball again. The umpires have a look but then give it back to the players. Holder is not too happy and he is having an animated discussion with umpire Illingworth, albeit with a smile.
Full and outside off, driven back to the bowler.
On the pads, flicked away for a couple. Aslam moves to 10.
A short ball around off, pulled through square leg for a single.

A BYE now. Full and wide outside off, Sami thinks about guiding the ball to third man but then pulls his bat away. The ball lands in front of Shane Dowrich but he is unable to collect cleanly. The ball goes through and this time there is third man in place where Kraigg Brathwaite does the mop up. A single taken.

FOUR! This time he finds the gap! A length ball slightly wider outside off, Aslam walks to the pitch of the ball, reaches out a bit and deftly angles his bat to guide the ball wide of second slip to the third man fence. Supernb adjustment. The lead moves to 231.
On a length around off, Aslam dabs it on the bounce to second slip.
A short ball on middle, Azhar tucks it through mid-wicket for a single.
MIGUEL CUMMINS to bowl from the other end.
Full and on middle, Aslam walks across and defends it back to the bowler.
Landed around off, pushed towards covers where the fielder makes a sliding stop to his right.
Down the leg side, flicked through square leg for a brace again.
Yorker length around leg, watchfully dug out.
On middle and leg, flicked through square leg for a couple.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
